In short, our ECOMMVERSE is your go-to address for e-accounts and all related products as well as a series of other services and benefits that make your business smoother and your life easier.

candidates.name: Flutterwave
candidates.description: At Flutterwave, we are on a mission to build payments infrastructure to connect Africa to the global economy. We do this by building technology, tools, and infrastructure for businesses and banks who want to provide a more seamless and secure payments experience for their customers. Founded in 2016 by a team of African finance and technology veterans from Standard Bank, PayPal, Google Wallet amongst others. Flutterwave has grown to become one of the fastest growing payments companies in the world. Since inception Flutterwave has processed close to $2 billion in payments and 25 million transactions across over 33 African countries where it currently operates. It has attracted significant investment from experienced Fintech investors such as Ycombinator Continuity Fund (investors in Stripe), Greycroft (investors in Braintree and Venmo), Greenvisor Capital, Omidyar Network, and Glynn Capital amongst others. In 2017 Flutterwave was named Africa’s best fintech company at the Apps Africa Innovation Awards.
candidates.rationale: Both are fintech platforms offering digital payments and financial services to businesses and consumers, with overlapping buyer personas.

candidates.name: Orcestro
candidates.description: Orcestro provides adaptable infrastructure for companies building modern digital payment and crypto-asset products. Book a call https://calendly.com/sdvdmr/30min We deliver branded solutions for wallets, payments, custody, brokerage, tokenization and transaction processing, all deployable quickly without long development cycles. Our platform is based on a modular technical framework that uses distributed services, flexible APIs and cloud-enabled deployment. It includes integrated security controls, transaction monitoring, key-management tools, KYC/KYB onboarding and automated compliance features. Each product can be adjusted to match your brand, regulatory environment and specific business flows. The Orcestro team has long-standing experience in fintech and virtual-asset implementation, supporting banks, PSPs, payment providers and national innovation programs across multiple regions. What companies build with Orcestro: • Custom mobile and Web3 wallets with integrated chat, transfers and secure storage • Global crypto-payment flows with automatic conversion and ready-to-use checkout modules • OTC desks, brokerage platforms and liquidity-routing solutions • Infrastructure for invoicing, recurring billing and large-scale payouts • Platforms for asset tokenization and secondary market operations Why teams choose Orcestro: • Fast deployment without hiring large engineering teams • Full brand and feature customization • Built-in compliance logic and risk-management modules • Pre-integrated connections to blockchains, banks, PSPs and liquidity providers • Continuous technical guidance and support Orcestro helps companies build and scale financial products faster, with less complexity and predictable delivery timelines
